name: morph-surface
title: Morph Surface
description: A spring-animated feedback widget that expands from a compact button into a full textarea on click. Includes a success indicator, Cmd+Enter submission, and Escape to close. Fully customizable dimensions, labels, and submit callbacks.
use: You want lightweight, in-situ feedback collection without leaving the page.
avoid: Accessibility is critical: custom render props mean you must handle ARIA and keyboard behavior yourself.
a11y: Core component provides focus-visible rings and basic button semantics. Escape closes; Cmd+Enter submits. Click-outside detection uses pointer events. If using custom renderContent, you must add ARIA…
